title: Nutty Velvety French Beef Shin Stew
description: A rich and nutty French beef shin stew that melts in your mouth, packed with protein and a velvety finish from almond butter—perfect for a post‑workout recovery meal.

ingredients.name: beef shin
ingredients.notes: cut into 2.5cm cubes, high protein braising cut

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic, sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef cubes and brown on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Pour in the red wine to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits, and let it reduce by half, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, then add the carrots and pour in the beef broth. Bring to a simmer.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and let the stew braise gently for 60 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the almond butter until fully incorporated for a silky, velvety consistency.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir in the toasted hazelnuts for a nutty finish.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh herbs.
